trait.name: Reeking Corpse
entries: The abomination emits an aura of toxic rot in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, any creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abomination makes two Cleaver attacks and one Crush attack. It can replace any attack with a Throw Flesh attack.

action.name: Cleaver
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from one of two arms. While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Throw Flesh
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Consume Life
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the abomination. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the abomination regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

monster.name: Aku'mai
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Aku'mai can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Aku'mai fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head Aku'mai has beyond one, it gets an extra {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} that can be used only for {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

trait.name: Tearing the Void (2/Day)
entries: Aku'mai has three heads. If it would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, its current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} total instead resets to 149 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it recharges its Caustic Bile, it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance, and one of its remaining heads dies. Additionally, it can now use one of the options in "Mythic Actions" for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 3,900 XP for defeating Aku'mai after the first time its Tearing the Void activates and an additional 3,900 XP after the second time (11,700 XP total).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Aku'mai makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Caustic Bile {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point Aku'mai can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Acid damage, and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Acid damage at the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half the initial damage only.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Aku'mai makes one Bite attack.

legendary.name: Quake Cavern
entries: Aku'mai causes the earth to quake and rocks to fall from above. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature within 30 feet of Aku'mai. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Aku'mai can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

If Aku'mai's Tearing the Void has activated in the last hour, it can use one of the options below as a Legendary Action. The first time Tearing the Void activates, Aku'mai gains access to Void Body; the second time, it gains access to Song of Ny'alotha.

mythic.name: Void Body
entries: Aku'mai's body extrudes a phantasmal tentacle of its true void form. {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature Aku'mai can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target gains 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

mythic.name: Song of Ny'alotha
entries: Aku'mai wails an otherworldly song. {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, one creature Aku'mai can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, which ends early if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Aku'mai can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Alleria fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Whispers of the Void
entries: Alleria emanates an aura in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} while she doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. {@actSave int} {@dc 21}, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Alleria makes four attacks, using Void Dagger or Windrunner's Bow in any combination.

action.name: Void Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 13}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Windrunner's Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 13}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Grasp of Emptiness {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 21}, each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point Alleria can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Psychic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved; the target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}; and it can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Void Stealth
entries: While in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, Alleria can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see that is also in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. She then has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of her next turn.

reaction.name: Spatial Rift
entries: {@actTrigger} Alleria is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} Alleria halves the damage (round down) she takes from that attack and then teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Fel Wildshape (2/Day)
entries: If Alzzin would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, his current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} total instead resets to 200 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, he can now use one of the options in "Mythic Actions" for 1 hour. The first time he uses it, he transforms into a Huge bear; award the characters an additional 10,000 XP for defeating him in this form. The second time he uses it, he transforms into a Large wolf; award the characters an additional 10,000 XP for defeating him in this form (30,000 XP total). Except for his size and Mythic Actions, his game statistics are unchanged when he shape-shifts.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Alzzin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Alzzin makes two Fel Claw attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Enervation and the other with a use of Wither.

action.name: Fel Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Enervation
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, one creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. If the target can cast spells, it can't use level 1 spell slots until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Wither
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, one creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength-based {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} and subtracts {@dice 1d8} from its damage rolls until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: Alzzin makes one Fel Claw attack.

legendary.name: Fel Inferno
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from Alzzin. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Alzzin can't use this action again until the start of his next turn.

If Alzzin's Fel Wildshape has activated in the last hour, he can use one of the options below as a Legendary Action. The first time Fel Wildshape activates, Alzzin gains access to Wrath of Mardum; the second time, he gains access to Alacrity of Xoroth.

mythic.name: Wrath of Mardum (Bear Form Only)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet straight away from Alzzin and drops one object of its choice that it's holding in the space it was pushed out of. For 1 minute, the object is wreathed in green flames and any creature holding the object has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws.

mythic.name: Alacrity of Xoroth (Wolf Form Only)
entries: Alzzin moves up to 60 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time Alzzin enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Slashing damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The ancient deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ancient makes three attacks, using Slam or Hurl Lightning in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 10 ft. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Lightning
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 500 ft. {@h}37 ({@damage 6d10 + 4}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Nature's Fury {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} originating from a point the ancient can see within 200 feet. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Piercing damage plus 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions until the start of the ancient's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Anduin casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

spellcasting.name: Divine Aid
headerEntries: Anduin casts {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Anduin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Anduin makes four attacks, using Shalamayne or Holy Fire in any combination.

action.name: Shalamayne
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Force damage.

action.name: Holy Fire
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 120 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) Fire damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Volley {@recharge 5}
entries: Anduin unleashes a wave of radiant energy in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, restoring 45 ({@dice 7d12}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to himself or an ally he can see in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSave dex} {@dc 19}, each enemy in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 7d12}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

reaction.name: Power Word: Shield
entries: {@actTrigger} Anduin is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} Anduin gains 25 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Anub'arak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Swarm Aura
entries: Anub'arak emanates a swarm of undead insects in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} while he doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of Anub'arak's turns, each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces Anub'arak to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, he makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a successful save, Anub'arak drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Anub'arak makes two attacks using Icy Claw or Crypt Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Icy Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d12 + 8}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Cold damage.

action.name: Crypt Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 120 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) Cold damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Necrotic damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} decreases by 20 feet until the start of Anub'arak's next turn.

reaction.name: Submerge (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} Anub'arak becomes {@status Bloodied|XPHB} or takes damage while {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. {@actResponse} Anub'arak moves up to his {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} into the ground. While underground, he has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from attacks and other effects outside the earth, and he regains 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of his turns. He emerges on his turn when he reaches his {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum or if all his allies within 120 feet of him are killed.

legendary.name: Crypt Bolt
entries: Anub'arak makes one Crypt Bolt attack.

legendary.name: Earth Spike
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on an earthen surface within 60 feet of Anub'arak. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Doan casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Arcane Bubble (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Doan would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, his current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} total instead resets to 165 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, he has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage until the start of his next turn, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, he can now use the Detonate action and the Anti-Spell Tome {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 5,900 XP (11,800 XP total) for defeating Doan after his Arcane Bubble activates.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Doan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Doan has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Doan makes three Arcane Explosion attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} if available.

action.name: Arcane Explosion
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) Force damage.

action.name: Detonate (Requires Arcane Bubble; Recharge 5-6)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature of Doan's choice within a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him. {@actSaveFail} 38 ({@damage 7d10}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Misty Step
entries: Doan teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet.

bonus.name: Anti-Spell Tome (Requires Arcane Bubble)
entries: Doan summons a floating tome in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of himself. The spellbook is an object that has AC 20, HP 25, {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage, and a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 20 feet, and it automatically succeeds on saving throws. Creatures other than Doan within 10 feet of the tome can't take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Dark Archangel Form (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
entries: If Ashbury would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, his current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} total instead resets to 82 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. He also gains a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet. Additionally, he can now use the option in "Mythic Actions" for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 1,100 XP (2,200 XP total) for defeating Ashbury after his Dark Archangel Form activates.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ashbury makes two Pain Blast attacks.

action.name: Pain Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Asphyxiate {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature of Ashbury's choice within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: Wracking Pain
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, one creature Ashbury can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Psychic damage.
If Baron Ashbury's Dark Archangel Form has activated in the last hour, he can use the option below as a Legendary Action.

mythic.name: Calamity
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature of Ashbury's choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him. {@actSaveFail} 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Ashbury can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Silverlaine can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. He takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Silverlaine makes one Object Slam attack and uses Telekinetic Thrust.

action.name: Object Slam
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrust
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one creature Silverlaine can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Force damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from Silverlaine.

legendary.name: Cursed Veil
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one creature Silverlaine can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Odo's Blinding Shadows
entries: The spirit of Odo the Blindwatcher hurls shadows at a foe. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, one creature Silverlaine can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of Silverlaine's next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Silverlaine can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary.name: Rethilgore's Soul Drain
entries: The spirit of Rethilgore feasts on an enemy's soul. {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one creature Silverlaine can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of Silverlaine's next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Silverlaine can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

dex.special: Your Strength and Dexterity scores are equal to your Wisdom score.

int.special: Your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma don't change.

wis.special: Your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma don't change.

cha.special: Your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma don't change.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: You make two Mangle attacks.

action.name: Mangle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d8} + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. This damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach Druid levels 5 ({@damage 2d8}), 11 ({@damage 3d8}), and 17 ({@damage 4d8}).

bonus.name: Frenzied Regeneration
entries: You expend a level 1+ spell slot and gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to five times the spell slot level.

reaction.name: Growl
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you. {@actResponse} You impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 feet of the target.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}):
will: {@spell Shapechange|XPHB} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} gained from the spell, and no Concentration or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} required to maintain the spell)

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 7d6 + 9}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Magma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 90-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Fire damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: Pounce
entries: The dragon moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Pyroclastic Eruption
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 60-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on the ground the dragon can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn, and the ground in the affected area becomes molten for 1 minute. While molten, the ground is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and any creature that ends its turn there starts {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The drake casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Heat Metal|XPHB} (level 7 version).

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}32 ({@damage 7d6 + 8}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Magma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Fire damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whelp makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Magma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Fire damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

spellcasting.name: Divine Flames (1/Day)
headerEntries: Thalnos casts {@spell Flame Strike|XPHB}, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Thalnos fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Thalnos makes three Shadow Bolt attacks.

action.name: Shadow Bolt
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Spirit Gale {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point Thalnos can see within 60 feet of him. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the start of Thalnos's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
entries: Thalnos casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Divine Flames.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}):
will: {@spell Shapechange|XPHB} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} gained from the spell, and no Concentration or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} required to maintain the spell)

spellcasting.name: Dispel

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft. {@h}30 ({@damage 6d6 + 9}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Razing Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 90-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Nonmagical plants in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} are incinerated and regrow at three times their normal rate, more bountifully than before.

legendary.name: Bellowing Roar
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} originating from the dragon. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Thunder damage, and the creature is pushed 10 feet away from the dragon. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Pounce
entries: The dragon moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Renewing Flame
entries: The dragon breathes a focused stream of heatless, life-giving fire. Each creature in a 90-foot long, 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} gains 21 ({@dice 6d6}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and the dragon ends one of the following conditions of its choice on those creatures: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The drake casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Command|XPHB} (level 2 version).

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}32 ({@damage 7d6 + 8}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Razing Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Nonmagical plants in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} are incinerated and regrow at three times their normal rate, more bountifully than before.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whelp makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Razing Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 42 ({@damage 12d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Nonmagical plants in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} are incinerated and regrow at three times their normal rate, more bountifully than before.

trait.name: Bloodied Defiance
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, Herod has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Herod fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Herod makes three Greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage.

bonus.name: Heroic Leap
entries: Herod jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement. He then has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll he makes before the end of this turn.

reaction.name: Vengeful Charge
entries: {@actTrigger} Herod is hit by a ranged attack roll. {@actResponse} Herod moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward the triggering creature without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

legendary.name: Frenzied Strike
entries: Herod makes a Greataxe attack.

legendary.name: Ravager's Cleave
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him. {@actSaveFail} 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Herod can't use this action again until the start of his next turn.

spellcasting.name: Sudden Strikes (1/Day)
headerEntries: Mograine casts {@spell Steel Wind Strike|XPHB}, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability ({@hit 10} to hit with spell attack).

trait.name: Consecrated Aura
entries: At the end of each of Mograine's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from him takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage, provided he doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Mograine fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mograine makes two Crusader Strike attacks.

action.name: Crusader Strike
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Radiant damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of Mograine's choice:

items.name: Blinded
entries: The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Staggered
entries: Until the end of the target's next turn, it can take an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The satyr makes two Fel Blade attacks.

action.name: Fel Blade
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, the satyr takes the {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

spellcasting.name: Fel Chant (3/Day)
headerEntries: The shivarra casts {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}, or {@spell Silence|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the shivarra dies outside the Twisting Nether, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body in {@dice 2d4} weeks, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} somewhere in the Twisting Nether.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shivarra has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The shivarra can take one {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on every turn of combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shivarra makes six Fel Blade attacks.

action.name: Fel Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage.

reaction.name: Deflect
entries: {@actTrigger} The shivarra is hit by a melee or ranged attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The shivarra adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: Eject Pilot
entries: This shredder can be piloted by a Small Humanoid. If the shredder is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it's destroyed and Sneed (Goblin Boss) leaps out. He lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the destroyed shredder.

trait.name: Headlamps
entries: The shredder casts {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shredder has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shredder makes two Steamsaw attacks and uses Terrify if available.

action.name: Steamsaw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Terrify {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, one creature within 20 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the specter has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

action.name: Screams of the Past (Wailing Guard Only)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the specter. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage, and the creature's {@status Concentration|XPHB} is broken.

action.name: Unholy Empowerment (Tormented Officer Only)
entries: One Undead creature within 5 feet of the specter regains 3 ({@dice 1d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Shield Wall (Tormented Officer Only)
entries: {@actTrigger} An ally within 5 feet of the specter is hit by a melee attack roll. {@actResponse} The target adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If Sylvanas is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the save and half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Sylvanas fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sylvanas makes three attacks, using Shadow Dagger or Windrunner's Bow in any combination.

action.name: Shadow Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 14}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Windrunner's Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have a dread wound, it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or receive a dread wound. While it has a dread wound, the target loses 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute or after a spell restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to the target.

action.name: Banshee Wail {@recharge}
entries: Sylvanas releases a mournful wail. {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, each creature within 60 feet that can hear the wail and isn't a Construct or an Undead. {@actSaveFail} If the target has 50 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer, it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Otherwise, the target takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
entries: Sylvanas teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

legendary.name: Strike
entries: Sylvanas makes one Shadow Dagger or Windrunner's Bow attack.

legendary.name: Veil of Darkness
entries: Sylvanas conjures a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} originating from a point she can see within 60 feet, which lasts until the end of her next turn. {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, any creature other than Sylvanas that starts its turn in this area or enters it for the first time on a turn. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Sylvanas can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Thrall fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Thrall makes three attacks, using Dra'gora or Lava Burst in any combination.

action.name: Dra'gora
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 5 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) damage of a type chosen by Thrall: Cold, Fire, or Lightning.

action.name: Lava Burst
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 13}, range 120 ft. {@h}31 ({@damage 9d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Chain Lightning {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 21}, one creature Thrall can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Lightning damage, and two bolts of lightning leap from the target to up to two other creatures of Thrall's choice, provided each is within 30 feet of the target; those creatures also make the saving throw, but no additional bolts leap from those targets.

bonus.name: Charge
entries: Thrall moves up to his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Spirit Wolf Strike
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 21}, one creature Thrall can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Force damage, and Thrall has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target until the end of his next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Thrall can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary.name: Strike
entries: Thrall makes one Dra'gora or Lava Burst attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Kelris casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

spellcasting.name: Counterspell (2/Day)
headerEntries: Kelris casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Kelris fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kelris makes three Mind Blast attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Sleep|XPHB}.

action.name: Mind Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The voidcaller has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The voidcaller makes two Void Burst attacks.

action.name: Void Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Force damage.

reaction.name: Reactive Resistance (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The voidcaller takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder damage. {@actResponse} The voidcaller gains {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage type (including for the triggering attack) until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The voidwalker has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Threatening Presence
entries: An enemy that starts its turn within 5 feet of the voidwalker has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature other than a voidwalker.

action.name: Consuming Shadows
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the voidwalker regains 3 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
